soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown from the marginal teeth to the tip, the posterior half deep yellow; postclypeus slightly deeper than the head, anteclypeus milky white, labrum, antennae and pronotum yellow, legs and abdomen pale yellow. The head has only several long hairs, the postclypeus four short hairs, the middle of the labrum with five pairs of hairs in longitudinal rows; the periphery of the pronotum with sparse long hairs, long hairs intermixed along the anterior margin. Head nearly circular, slightly wider than long, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave; postclypeus raised; labrum nearly tongue-shaped, longer than wide, its tip rather straight; the front of the mandibles curved inwards like a sickle, each with one inner marginal tooth behind the middle; postmentum short and stout, its sides slightly convex outwards at the middle. Antennae with 14 segments, the fourth shortest, the second and third about equal. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the middle of the anterior margin concave, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2, tarsi with four segments.
